hook_text: Every size divided by twenty. Knife on the mat. Check before glue. That is how a model earns 35 marks.
clip_script: Scale 1:20: the ramp is 360 long, risers 7.5, rails 45. Card for concrete, polystyrene for fill, dowel for rails, a hardboard base. Make the conversion table first, every drawing size divided by 20, checked by a teammate, pinned up. Then safety: knife on a mat, fingers back, cut away in light passes, cap it. Change blunt blades; blunt is what slips. Glue gun on its stand, cold water bowl ready. Then build in flow chart order: plan on the base, ramp legs, check 360 for 1 in 12, glue. Steps, check all risers equal, glue. Landing flat. Posts every 75, upright, 45 high. Rails. Paint, texture. Photograph front, top and side. Tick the specs.
visual_style: Whiteboard bench layout; a conversion table filling; knife and glue gun with safety icons; the model rising stage by stage with a check tick before each glue.
mood: Workshop focus, calm hands, pride in the finish.
pacing: Materials and table, safety rules, build sequence with checks, the record.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a 1:20 conversion table for your own front step.
